criteria_results.text: Session History transcripts render for tool-using sessions (not '(empty message)')
criteria_results.notes: Real app click-through against the branch backend: 'Memory Consolidation' and 'daily-morning-briefing' (both tool-using) rendered full Input+Output transcripts. Backend probe: GET /agent-sessions/:id/messages returned 63/63 msgs, 248 parts. Reported symptom fixed.

criteria_results.text: (adjacent, not in #999 scope) errored/failed sessions render a transcript or empty-state
criteria_results.notes: User: 'failed sessions show nothing'. Two cases confirmed via :4001: (1) interrupted 0-msg sessions have no transcript (need empty-state); (2) aborted-with-content sessions (e.g. 0788f045 = 70 msgs/226 parts) — endpoint returns parts but UI blanks them. Backend serves the data; gap is view-side. NOT a #999 regression — filed as follow-up #1006.

process_issues.description: Production task server api.vcrcapps.com returned HTTP 502 during smoke, blocking the desktop shell's prod-health gate. Worked around with --dart-define=RHYTHM_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:4001 so the agents-server screens (#999/#1000, hardcoded to :4001) could be smoked. Prod outage is unrelated to this PR.
process_issues.detected_by: curl https://api.vcrcapps.com/health -> 502; app error screen 'Could not reach the Rhythm server'
